video_title: Debating if Trae Young is as GOOD as Jalen Brunson 👀

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson argues the Wizards will surprise people this season
quotes.excerpt: If we come back here into the studio and they are a top six seed, I would not be shocked.
quotes.quote: If we come back here into the studio and they are a top six seed, I would not be shocked. Trae Young is good enough, Anthony Davis is good enough, and AJ Griffin can flat out go. You got Chris Middleton over there, you got Deandre Ayton, he is not a starting big, but a backup big. They got a good basketball team.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Charlie Villanueva questions if Trae Young is a true number one
quotes.excerpt: Isn't he supposed to be the one that draws doubles as a number one?

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: Can I ask you guys a question about Trae Young? Isn't he supposed to be the one that draws doubles as a number one? I have never heard Steph Curry say this, I have never heard LeBron James say this, I have never heard Kevin Durant say this. I have never heard a guy I would consider true number one say that. They say what?

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: That he has never had a teammate that can draw a double.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson defends Trae Young's talent compared to Jalen Brunson
quotes.excerpt: I think if you put a really good basketball team around Trae Young, he is going to win.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: I think if you put a really good basketball team around Trae Young, he is going to win a championship. I think he is really good.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: You think he is as good as Jalen Brunson? That is my question.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: I think he can win a championship. I am not saying he is as talented as Jalen Brunson. I am saying he can win a championship.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson praises the Knicks' team construction and coaching
quotes.excerpt: It was a perfectly built basketball team.
quotes.quote: Do we really understand how good the Knicks team was? Are we not really understanding what they had as a whole? It was a perfectly built basketball team. Not saying Jalen Brunson is not great, but it was a perfectly built basketball team.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson argues Trae Young's impact on opposing defenses
quotes.excerpt: Trae Young puts fear in people's heart at the end of the game.
quotes.quote: I don't know what y'all are not realizing. Trae Young puts fear in people's heart at the end of the game.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson emphasizes the importance of players knowing their roles
quotes.excerpt: The point of everything is does everyone understand their role?
quotes.quote: The point of everything is does everyone understand their role? Why were the Utah Jazz so good every single year? Everyone knew their role. There were no egos and they played for each other. That beats a great basketball team majority of the time, unless you run against a Kobe Bryant. But Kobe Bryant had these motherfuckers playing good basketball.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Raymond Felton credits Mike Brown for the Knicks' success
quotes.excerpt: I think it took for New York to win, and there is nothing against Tom Thibodeau.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: I think it took for New York to win, and there is nothing against Tom Thibodeau. I think Tom Thibodeau is one of the best coaches that we have seen in this game, but I think Mike Brown, what he did with this team was different. He actually played his bench. He actually used everybody throughout the year, even in the playoffs, and I think that kind of got the Knicks over the hump.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: What are you talking about? Tom Thibodeau is the coach.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Raymond Felton discusses the importance of having two main guys
quotes.excerpt: He was missing two guys, two main guys.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: He was missing two guys, two main guys. He won when he had his main guys, right? When they were healthy.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Who is the other main guy?

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: The panel debates Tyrese Haliburton versus Trae Young
quotes.excerpt: Who are you picking, Haliburton or Trae Young? That is the conversation.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Who are you picking, Haliburton or Trae Young? That is the conversation.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: Me? I would probably go Trae.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson argues Trae Young's passing ability is underrated
quotes.excerpt: You don't think Trae Young can do that? He can't kick the ball ahead?
quotes.quote: So you are telling me you don't think Trae Young can do that? He can't kick the ball ahead? He can't play fast? I think he can do that. I think he is just ball dominant. I think Tyrese Haliburton moves the ball a lot quicker.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Raymond Felton argues that basketball is more than just numbers
quotes.excerpt: It ain't just the numbers. It is more than that.
quotes.quote: But that is why as basketball players, we need to understand it ain't just the numbers. It is more than that.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Raymond Felton and Theo Pinson debate the best player on the Jazz
quotes.excerpt: Boozer averaged more points than Deron Williams, but who was the main player on that team?

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: Boozer averaged more points than Deron Williams, but who was the main player on that team?

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson argues Deron Williams was the best player on the Jazz
quotes.excerpt: You are the head coach, who you get the ball to at the end of the game?
quotes.quote: You are the head coach, who you get the ball to at the end of the game? Between him and Boozer? Yes.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Raymond Felton asserts Deron Williams was the primary decision maker
quotes.excerpt: He is the fucking point guard. He decided to move the ball.
quotes.quote: He is the fucking point guard. He decided to move the ball.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson argues Pascal Siakam needs to be fed the ball
quotes.excerpt: You don't get the best Pascal Siakam if you don't feed him.
quotes.quote: You don't get the best Pascal Siakam if you don't feed him.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson compares Steve Nash and Amar'e Stoudemire
quotes.excerpt: Who averaged more points with Phoenix, Steve Nash or Amar'e?
quotes.quote: Who averaged more points with Phoenix, Steve Nash or Amar'e? Amar'e. Who is the better player?

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson notes Steve Nash's MVP awards
quotes.excerpt: Steve Nash is a two-time MVP.
quotes.quote: Steve Nash is a two-time MVP.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson argues Amar'e Stoudemire led the Suns in scoring
quotes.excerpt: Amar'e led them in scoring, but you go around the league and say who is the best player?
quotes.quote: Amar'e led them in scoring, but you go around the league and say who is the best player on Phoenix? It is going to say Steve Nash. He controlled everything.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson discusses Atlanta's improvement after Trae Young's injury
quotes.excerpt: When he left and he went to Indiana, they got better.
quotes.quote: When he left and he went to Indiana, they got better.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson praises Trae Young's ability to draw fouls
quotes.excerpt: Trae Young, because he knows how to draw fouls with the best of them.
quotes.quote: Trae Young, because he knows how to draw fouls with the best of them. That shit is annoying as fuck, I am not going to hold you. But he just finds a way.
